theorem section_mul (q r : Q) :
    σ q * σ r = S.inl (factor S σ q r) * σ (q * r) := by
  rw [inl_factor, inv_mul_cancel_right]
noncomputable def conjAct : E →* MulAut N where
theorem inl_conjAct_comm {e : E} {n : N} : S.inl (S.conjAct e n) = e * S.inl n * e⁻¹ := by

theorem conj_apply [Group G] (g h : G) : conj g h = g * h * g⁻¹ :=
  rfl

theorem map_mul [MulHomClass F M N] (f : F) (x y : M) : f (x * y) = f x * f y :=
  MulHomClass.map_mul f x y
